answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows.. This is resilient because unearned rewards are capped and eventually burned, so an attacker cannot bank on a runaway Sybil campaign paying off. Consider a willow as the anchor of the cost.
